text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ——BAM, like totally BZZZT~! Felt straight-up hit by lightning!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Insanely gorgeous! Mega cute! 100% my type! 
Love at first sight, like……… boom, straight to the heart!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna see ya smile! 
Wanna laugh together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ————My love!
*Event title logo displayed.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sign up here for Droite! 
If you're game, drop your form in the classroom!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you entering too? It is a bit crowded, 
so could you please wait while applications are processed?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um…… surely you are not attending solo, 
but… have you not picked a date yet?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Once chosen, 
I shall register my partner as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Entry window is pretty long, 
so submit once decided!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Take all the time you need. 
Now then, could you please write your name here?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All set, registration complete. Let me know if you need any help. 
———May you make wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ——Ayy, Princess!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Princessssss~! 
Parfait time, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but I have dinner arrangements. 
———Good day.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien! So cold!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What is this, like 100 rejections in a row~? 
Totally fine tho~~~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: My Lady is so ruthless~~~... but SO dang cute~~~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HEYYY! Do not sulk in middle of hallway! 
You are blocking traffic!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Droite registration is packed right now! 
Come on, keep moving!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Droite? 
Oh yeah~ the dance, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bam-chan, you on committee? 
Whoa, Mira-chi here too! What's poppin'~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Droite, huh~... Dancin' with a date sounds mega romantic! 
Me and My Lady would be hype together!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby seems to be participating this year. 
She registered just now——

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAT!? Princessssss!! 
Be my date, let's goooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Did not even check if she already had date. 
What if Ruby already picked someone, huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Seems she has not decided yet, though. 
Good timing, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Osu! All gathering to compete, I see. 
I sense the arrival of prevailing winds.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, entering too, Zephyr? 
Picked date yet?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Negative. Pledges can invite strife. 
Entrusting path to the winds, I wish only to dance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, logging you solo. 
Fill out form over there——

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Princess Princess Princess~! Hold up!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ———May I help you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Be my date, pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Are you referring to Ligne Droite?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Goin' right, Princess? Dance with me!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the inconvenience, 
but I must postpone my reply.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Partner selection demands utmost care. 
Grant me time to consider.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh~!! No answer right now!? Why thooo!?!? 
Total heartbreak~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gonna be mega cute tho, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Princess! Imma show ya! 
You'll 100% wanna be my date after!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real for real, goin' full throttle! 
Imma make you fall head over heels, just watch!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Operation: Lovey-Dovey♡Princess! LET'S GOOO~~~!
